where.if: AND ( c.customer_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.ali_open_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.wechat_open_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND bc.customer_id IS NULL AND c.status <> 'ACTIVE'
AND bc.customer_id IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM customer c LEFT JOIN black_customer bc ON c.customer_id = bc.customer_id AND bc.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT c.customer_id, c.user_name, c.mobile, c.ali_open_id, c.wechat_open_id, c.status, c.create_time, MAX(o.create_time) AS last_order_time, CASE WHEN bc.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'BLACKLIST' WHEN c.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS manager_status FROM customer c LEFT JOIN black_customer bc ON c.customer_id = bc.customer_id AND bc.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN order_info o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.user_name, c.mobile, c.ali_open_id, c.wechat_open_id, c.status, c.create_time, bc.customer_id ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT c.customer_id, c.user_name, c.mobile, c.ali_open_id, c.wechat_open_id, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.remarks, CASE WHEN bc.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND bc.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'BLACKLIST' WHEN c.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS manager_status FROM customer c LEFT JOIN black_customer bc ON c.customer_id = bc.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, customer_id, status, order_no, agreement_no, sign_time, ali_open_id, create_time, update_time FROM customer_agreement_sign WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT order_no, device_id, gate_id, order_amount, pay_amount, coupon_amount, order_status, create_time, update_time FROM order_info WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM customer c LEFT JOIN black_customer bc ON c.customer_id = bc.customer_id AND bc.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND bc.customer_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM customer c LEFT JOIN black_customer bc ON c.customer_id = bc.customer_id AND bc.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.status <> 'ACTIVE' AND bc.customer_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM black_customer WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO black_customer(customer_id, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{customerId}, #{status}, now(), now()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = #{status}, update_time = now()

INSERT INTO customer(customer_id, user_name, mobile, ali_open_id, wechat_open_id, status, create_time, update_time, remarks) VALUES(#{customerId}, #{userName}, #{mobile}, #{aliOpenId}, #{wechatOpenId}, 'ACTIVE', now(), now(), #{remarks}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_name = VALUES(user_name), mobile = VALUES(mobile), ali_open_id = VALUES(ali_open_id), wechat_open_id = VALUES(wechat_open_id), update_time = now(), remarks = VALUES(remarks)
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET user_name = #{userName}, mobile = #{mobile}, ali_open_id = #{aliOpenId}, wechat_open_id = #{wechatOpenId}, remarks = #{remarks}, update_time = now() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
